notes.title: Silent Seeker is now FREE TO PLAY!
notes.notes: [p][b]We’re excited to announce that [i]Silent Seeker[/i] is now completely free to play![/b][/p][p][b]This wasn’t part of our original plan, but after listening to player feedback and looking at how the community has grown, we realized that the game has much more potential as a free-to-play experience. We want to make it accessible to as many players as possible and build a bigger, more active community around it.[/b][/p][p][b]Everyone who already owns the game will of course continue to have full access — and as a thank you, we’re working on some exclusive cosmetics or rewards that will be rolled out soon to show our appreciation for your support. 💖[/b][/p][p][b]We can’t wait to see more of you join the hunt. See you in-game![/b][/p][p][b]— The [i]Silent Seeker[/i] Team[/b][/p]
